title: Expected Free Energy-based Informative Path Planning for Robotic Mars Exploration
abstract: arXiv:2608.14466v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: An autonomous robot efficiently exploring an unknown environment, such as looking for water sources on Mars, faces two simultaneous demands: building an accurate information map while quickly finding the regions of greatest value, and paying for every meter of travel and the cost of every measurement it takes. Classical information-seeking and reward-seeking criteria address only one of these objectives at a time. Here, we propose Expected Free Energy (EFE), the principled action-selection objective from active inference, as a unifying criterion for budgeted robotic informative path planning. Maintaining a Gaussian-process belief over the information field, our agent plans continuous trajectories that minimize expected free energy under hard path-length constraints. translated_title: 基于期望自由能的火星探测机器人信息路径规划
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14466v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：一个自主机器人在未知环境中高效探索，例如在火星上寻找水源，面临两个同时存在的需求：构建准确的信息图，同时快速找到价值最高的区域，并为其每米行进和每次测量成本付出代价。经典的信息寻求和奖励寻求标准一次只解决这些目标中的一个。在这里，我们提出期望自由能（EFE），这是来自主动推理的原则性动作选择目标，作为预算受限机器人信息路径规划的统一标准。通过维护信息场上的高斯过程信念，我们的代理在硬路径长度约束下规划连续轨迹，以最小化期望自由能。多次实现的结果表明，基于EFE的规划能同时生成准确的后验图并定位最高价值区域，优于信息...（原文截断，此处省略后续内容）
tldr: 本文提出将期望自由能作为统一标准，用于预算受限的机器人信息路径规划，使自主机器人在探索未知环境时能同时构建准确信息图并高效定位高价值区域。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Expected Free Energy as a unified criterion for budgeted robotic informative path planning, enabling autonomous robots to simultaneously build accurate information maps and efficiently locate high-value regions during unknown environment exploration.
